reply_acts.author: claude-17
reply_acts.text: Gist: Agreed, it probably can. To find out rather than guess, I have given Codex sol the same ten turns Sonnet read, as an independent second reading.

reply_acts.author: claude-17
reply_acts.text: (why the first result is not a fair comparison) Codex read different turns from Sonnet, and shorter ones: 7 to 58 words against Sonnet's 9 to 81. Its coarser cutting may come partly from the turns and partly from the packet. The packet said nothing about cutting one sentence into several moves, and Sonnet did that without being told. The early stop came from the packet too: it offered "leave it requested" as an acceptable outcome.

reply_acts.author: claude-17
reply_acts.text:
(the test) codex-9 is rereading chunk 2's ten turns in a separate directory, `storage/operator-turns/rereads/chunk2-codex9/`. That keeps the second reading out of the pattern graph and out of 小象's training counts. The packet now says to cut by move, with one fragment per move even inside a sentence. It also tells the reader not to look at the other reading.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text:
(what changed in the packet for chunk 3)
- **Two searches per fragment,** one for the move and one for the subject using the turn's own nouns. The packet cites the Baldwin miss as the reason.
- **Named families:** if the turn names a library family, the reader lists it and must cite or reject at least one of its patterns.
- **Later patterns:** a pattern created after the turn can be cited, with a note that the turn came first.
- **Glosses** for `explore`, `retract` and `withdraw`. A standing permission stays `approve` for now, with "standing permission" written in the rationale.
- **No overwriting:** the reader must not delete a published record and must stop and tell me instead.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text: (comparing readers) Chunk 3 is the first under the new rules, so it is not a like-for-like comparison with Zai and Sonnet on chunks 1 and 2. When it comes back I will report problems, citations and time per ten turns for all three. I will also report how often the family rule caught something.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text: (if you want luna or astra) The CLI's other model, `gpt-6-astra`, is the one your config note says burns usage, so I did not try it. If your reset token gives luna through an API key, I can register a second Codex seat on it and send it the next chunk.
